newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SKorea's largest labour group say strikes still on.
newsitem.headline: SKorea's largest labour group say strikes still on.

text.p: South Korea's largest labour union body said on Friday it will go ahead with strikes planned for Monday and Thursday next week unless the government scraps planned changes to the labour law.
"There are no changes to our plans," said an official at the press office of the Federation of Korean Trade Unions.
"It depends on the labour law. If they don't cancel the changes, we will go ahead with our strikes."
The umbrella trade union, which represents 1.2 million workers at 800 companies, plans to hold a one hour stoppage on Monday and a three-hour walkout on Thursday.
